name: One Flesh
overview: The biblical concept of 'One Flesh' emphasizes the divine design for marriage as a permanent union between a man and a woman, instituted by God from the beginning. Genesis 2:24 establishes that a man shall leave his parents and cleave to his wife, becoming one flesh, a truth reaffirmed by Jesus in Matthew 19:4 and 19:6, who underscores that what God has joined together must not be separated by man. The Scriptures also uphold the sanctity of this union by condemning divorce and remarriage except in cases of fornication (Matthew 19:9; Luke 16:18), highlighting the covenantal and exclusive nature of marriage. Additionally, Exodus 22:16 reflects the seriousness of entering into this one-flesh relationship, requiring a man who lies with an unbetrothed maid to marry her, thereby recognizing the permanence and responsibility inherent in the marital bond.
